---
title: "School Mapping"
author: "Yvette Yan"
date: "2026-07-08"
output: html_document
---

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

schools_df <- read.csv("All_schools.csv", check.names = FALSE)
schools_sf <- st_as_sf(schools_df, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

csa_boundaries <- st_read("Baltimore_CSA.geojson")
csa_boundaries <- st_transform(csa_boundaries, crs = 4326)

csa_boundaries$school_count <- lengths(st_intersects(csa_boundaries, schools_sf))

csa_boundaries <- csa_boundaries %>%
  mutate(
    fill_col = case_when(
      school_count >= 3 ~ "#08519c",  
      school_count == 2 ~ "#3182bd",  
      school_count == 1 ~ "#9ecae1",  
      TRUE ~ "transparent"            
    ),
    fill_opac = ifelse(school_count == 0, 0, 0.6) 
  )

pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#d93f3c", "#2e7d32"), 
  domain = schools_sf$School_Type
)

interactive_map <- leaflet() %>%
  
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  addPolygons(data = csa_boundaries,
              fillColor = ~fill_col,        
              fillOpacity = ~fill_opac,     
              color = "#4a6fa5",            
              weight = 2,                 
              dashArray = "5, 5",         
              
              highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                weight = 3,
                color = "#2c3e50",        
                fillColor = "#ffeb9b",      
                fillOpacity = 0.7,
                bringToFront = FALSE 
              ),
              
              label = ~CSA2020, 
              labelOptions = labelOptions(
                style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "3px 8px"),
                textsize = "13px",
                direction = "auto"
              )) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(data = schools_sf,
                   color = ~pal(School_Type),
                   fillColor = ~pal(School_Type),
                   fillOpacity = 0.8,
                   radius = 4,                
                   weight = 1,
                   clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(), 
                   
                   label = ~lapply(paste0(
                     "<b>", School_Name, 
                     "<br/>Principal Name:", Principal_Name,
                     "<br/>Email:", Principal_Email,
                     "<br/>Recreation Center Nearby:", Recreation_Center,
                     "<br/>Phone:", Contact,
                     "<br/>Council member:", Council_member,
                     "<br/>Phone:", Concilmember_Phone,
                     "<br/>Email:", Concilmember_Email
                     ), HTML),
                   
                   labelOptions = labelOptions(
                     style = list("color" = "#333333", padding = "4px 8px"),
                     textsize = "14px",
                     direction = "top"
                   )
  )

print(interactive_map)

saveWidget(interactive_map, "Baltimore_Target_All30_Interactive.html")
